content_md: I open up the tens of tabs I have open in the browser on my phone at any one time to try and find a specific one that comes to mind. I mistakenly tap an *X* whilst scrolling and I see the brief motion that signals a tab has just been deleted. I mourn for a moment, wondering what that tab could have become and meant to my existence, had I not just purged it.
